title: Corrupt Acacia
body:
Description

The Corrupt Acacia is part of the 2024 Halloween update. It can be obtained by exposing Acacia to a spore made by Mysterious Mushrooms (Formally found in the Desert on the Ferwater Island in the Corrupt Biome)

Just a corrupted version of the Acacia tree. Despite being the corrupted version of the Acacia , it resembles a willow tree but in purple hue.

NOTE: They have been confirmed as permanent.

🟣| The Corruption

  • The corruption is spreading all over the Desert... Something doesn't seem right...
  • These (PERMANENT) materials have been added: The Corrupted, Corrupted Acacia Tree, Corrupted Cactus, Corrupted Deadwood, Corrupted Tumbleweed, and Corrupted Limestone.[1]
